We also role played this conversation minus the name spelling:

Anna: Hello! How are you?

    ASL: HELLO. HOW YOU?

Sarah: Hi! I am good, thank you. How are you?

    ASL: HI. I GOOD, THANK-YOU. HOW YOU?

Anna: I am fine. My name is Anna. What is your name?

    ASL: I FINE. MY NAME A-N-N-A (fingerspelled). YOUR NAME WHAT?

Sarah: Nice to meet you. My name is Sarah.

    ASL: NICE MEET YOU. MY NAME S-A-R-A-H (fingerspelled).

Anna: Nice to meet you too.
